title: STaR, V-STaR and Quiet-STaR — V-STaR: Adding a Verifier

desc: V-STaR also trains a verifier on both correct and incorrect solutions to pick the best candidate.

title: STaR, V-STaR and Quiet-STaR — Quiet-STaR: Thinking Between Tokens

desc: Quiet-STaR trains a model to generate short internal thoughts at every token position in general text.
objectives: Describe thoughts generated at each token.
Explain the reward: better prediction of following text.
